name: hud_ui_show_chat_line
description: HudUi::ShowChatLine pushes a chat message into the global chat-message text stack only when that stack is enabled.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent HudUiTextStack/HUD source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4138f0 validates fastcall message in ECX, duration on the stack, reading g_HudUiChatMessageStack, checking base.enabled at offset 4, forwarding message and duration to HudUiTextStack4::PushLine only when enabled, and callee stack cleanup.
The native text-stack smoke verifies ShowChatLine does not push while the chat stack is disabled and pushes the supplied message/duration while enabled.
